title: Dancing With All His Might
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The holy Ark came up the road,
To David's city bright.
And David could not hold his joy,
He danced with all his might!

[Chorus]
So sing and dance and show your love
For God who lights the way.
Heavenly Father loves your joy,
So praise Him night and day.

[Verse 2]
His wife said, "Kings should not act so!
You look so silly, dear."
But David laughed, "I dance for God!"
His joy was true and clear.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, the dance is done,
Your feet can rest awhile.
Heavenly Father saw your joy,
He's near you with a smile.

[Chorus]
mood: Dancing music. A light, skipping sway bounces under the voice like happy feet on a city street, bright and unashamed, matching David's whole-hearted joy before the Ark. The chorus lifts with a clap-along lilt a child could sway to in bed. By the last verse the skip slows to a gentle rock, lower and softer, as the dancing feet finally rest under the blanket.
